duties.duty: MP-0(a): Supply in complete form, in the owned body and annex, BGG 1997 Sect. 2.1.2 Exercise 2.1.31 (book pp. 35-36; PDF pp. 42-43). Show that rho_{M,prec} can be chosen as a formula of the form forall x Zx and forall x exists u forall y phi. Here Z is a monadic predicate symbol, and phi contains no variables other than x, u, y and uses only the three binary predicate symbols H, T_0, K plus finitely many monadic predicate symbols. The source's hint: use the universality of Turing machines with binary alphabet {0,1}, read Zx as x=0, and incorporate START into phi as Zy -> START[0/y]. Give a written proof, and add the following Remark (forall y Hyy). No handbook file treats Exercise 2.1.31. The existing rho_{M,prec} (def:p02-w02-p02-036-refined) uses S, the prefix forall x exists u exists v forall y, and a binary T_a for each tape letter, so it is not of the required form. Items (b)-(f) of MP-0 are covered at body 91-667 and annex 12-902.
